title: Birds: spot the Critically Endangered
intro: Conservation status of birds, using the IUCN Red List categories as recorded on Wikidata.

questions.prompt: Which of these species is recorded as Critically Endangered?
questions.explain: Ivory-billed Woodpecker: Critically Endangered. Graceful Pitta: Least Concern; Arabian Partridge: Least Concern; Eastern Bonelli's Warbler: Least Concern. Status as recorded on Wikidata (IUCN Red List categories), retrieved 2026-10-12.
